title: Lower Power: Squat
warmup: 2 rounds: 1:00 bike or 200m jog · 10 leg swings / side · 10 walking lunges · 3 × 10-yd A-skips
jumps: Back squat 3 → Box jump 5 → DB squat jump 5 → Fast pogos 10
Squat @ RPE 8 · DBs 15–25% bodyweight · Rest 3:00 · max intent
No hurdles? Tuck jumps, same reps
strength: Lower as slowly as you can · band assist OK
note: Same squat weight is fine. Make the jumps higher and the DBs a little heavier.
